name: Alzheimer disease microglia-resolved genetics
applicability: AD GWAS or fine-mapping results are available
Brain single-cell or microglia-specific data can be queried
The question targets cell-type-specific mechanisms rather than amyloid biomarkers alone

evidence_links.decision_rule: Only assign a mechanism to a cell type with explicit enrichment evidence
evidence_links.why_this_link: AD risk genes are enriched in microglia; without cell-type resolution the same locus is uninterpretable

evidence_links.decision_rule: Require a perturbation readout in the proposed cell state before GO
evidence_links.why_this_link: Expression enrichment in microglia does not prove the gene drives the disease-relevant state

stop_downgrade_rules: Do not translate a variant association into a drug mechanism without a microglia or neuron anchor
Keep APOE and amyloid-pathway effects separate from cell-type-specific risk genes
Downgrade to CONDITIONAL_GO when only one independent evidence class exists
mixed_method_rationale: AD genetics is dominated by microglia-enriched risk genes, so the paper-style strategy resolves cell type early; starting with bulk omics would bury the strongest signal in cell-mix averages.
boundary_notes: Microglia enrichment is observational and does not establish the disease-driving cell state

name: Asthma shared genetics to epithelial IL33 axis
applicability: GWAS for asthma or related allergic traits is available
Airway epithelial or immune-cell expression data can be queried
The question targets type-2 inflammation mechanisms

evidence_links.decision_rule: Only advance a locus to a gene when expression and genetic evidence point to the same effector
evidence_links.why_this_link: Shared genetics across allergic traits concentrates signal on epithelial alarmins such as IL33

stop_downgrade_rules: Do not claim an antibody target is validated by genetics alone
Stop when the epithelial versus immune-cell direction of action is unresolved
Report the heterogeneity across allergic traits instead of merging them silently
mixed_method_rationale: Allergic-trait GWAS shares a strong epithelial alarmin signal, so the strategy starts with genetics and immediately checks airway epithelial expression; this picks IL33-like axes that generic immune-cell omics would miss.
boundary_notes: Shared genetics across traits does not mean one mechanism explains all allergic disease

source_papers.title: Shared genetic origin of asthma, hay fever and eczema elucidates allergic disease biology

name: Coronary artery disease lipid genetics to drug target
applicability: CAD GWAS plus lipid-trait genetics are available
The question targets metabolic or lipoprotein mechanisms
A clinical or genetic validation path (e.g., LDL cholesterol) can be linked

evidence_links.decision_rule: Only carry forward genes with a coherent lipid or vascular biology story
evidence_links.why_this_link: CAD is polygenic; the PCSK9-style successes came from genes with a clear lipid mechanism

evidence_links.decision_rule: Prefer targets with congruent genetic effect direction and drug mechanism
evidence_links.why_this_link: Human genetics predicted the efficacy and safety of LDL-lowering drugs before large trials

stop_downgrade_rules: Do not prioritize a gene whose genetic effect direction opposes the proposed drug mechanism
Stop if the target lacks a measurable biomarker readout for validation
Safety signals from genetics (e.g., pleiotropic effects) must stay visible
mixed_method_rationale: CAD target discovery has historically succeeded by starting from lipid biology and confirming with human genetics, not the reverse; the pattern begins with genetics for causality but immediately requires a mechanism and a measurable biomarker before any drug claim.
boundary_notes: Genetics-supported LDL biology is not a guarantee of clinical benefit for other mechanisms

source_papers.title: A comprehensive 1,000 Genomes-based genome-wide association meta-analysis of coronary artery disease
Sequence variations in PCSK9, low LDL, and protection against coronary heart disease

name: IBD genetics to drug-repurposing target
applicability: GWAS or fine-mapping results for IBD or its subtypes exist
Intestinal tissue eQTL or single-cell data are available
The task cares about druggable and already-validated target classes

evidence_links.decision_rule: Prefer genes that are both genetically associated and already druggable when all else is equal
evidence_links.why_this_link: IBD GWAS genes are enriched for validated therapeutic targets, making drug enrichment a high-yield early filter

evidence_links.decision_rule: Require a cell-type and disease-stage annotation before writing mechanism statements
evidence_links.why_this_link: The same gene can be protective in epithelium and pathogenic in myeloid cells

stop_downgrade_rules: Do not equate genetic association with direction of therapeutic effect
Stop when the associated gene has no credible cell-type anchor in gut tissue
Keep opposing-direction evidence across cell states as a blocker, not a weighted average
mixed_method_rationale: IBD genetics is unusually actionable: validated drug targets are enriched among GWAS genes, so the paper starts with genetics and immediately checks druggability, then resolves cell type with intestinal omics; generic omics-first pipelines would dilute the strongest translational signal.
boundary_notes: Genetics-to-drug enrichment is a prioritization heuristic, not proof that a drug will work

Genome-wide association study implicates immune activation and multiple pathogenetic mechanisms in Crohn's disease

name: Parkinson disease genetics plus Mendelian randomization
applicability: PD GWAS and eQTL/pQTL data are available
Mendelian randomization is appropriate (exposure-outcome question)
The task can include lysosomal or mitochondrial mechanism evidence

evidence_links.decision_rule: Use MR only when instruments pass pleiotropy and strength checks; report sensitivity analyses
evidence_links.why_this_link: Observational protein-disease associations in PD are heavily confounded; genetics provides the direction anchor

stop_downgrade_rules: Do not report MR as causal evidence when pleiotropy checks fail
Stop when the proposed mechanism lacks any lysosomal, mitochondrial or dopaminergic anchor
Keep GBA and LRRK2 as distinct mechanistic branches rather than merging them
mixed_method_rationale: PD GWAS alone leaves direction ambiguous, so the paper-style strategy pairs genetics with MR and then branches into lysosomal versus mitochondrial mechanisms; a fixed omics-first pipeline would miss the genetic prior.
boundary_notes: MR is a genetic instrumental-variable analysis, not a substitute for perturbation experiments

source_papers.title: Identification of novel risk loci, causal insights, and heritable risk for Parkinson's disease

name: Perturbation-first cell-state target identification
applicability: A disease-relevant cell state can be modelled in vitro
Genetics hits are weak, absent, or not yet mapped
A Perturb-seq / Perturb-CITE-seq atlas or oracle is available
The task cares about gene-to-phenotype direction inside a defined cell state

evidence_links.decision_rule: A gene is a candidate only when its perturbation shifts a pre-registered cell-state signature
evidence_links.why_this_link: Pooled perturbation screens give direction and cell-state context that static expression cannot

stop_downgrade_rules: Do not extrapolate an in vitro cell state to the disease without a genetics or tissue anchor
Stop when the screen cell state is not the disease-relevant state
Report guide-level QC failures instead of averaging them away
mixed_method_rationale: When genetics is unresolved, the paper-style strategy starts from a saturated perturbation atlas in the disease-relevant cell state and works backward; a genetics-first pipeline would have nothing to anchor on.
boundary_notes: Screen context must match the disease cell state; out-of-context atlases are exploration only

source_papers.title: Mapping information-rich genotype-phenotype landscapes with genome-scale Perturb-seq

name: Rheumatoid arthritis druggable-genome prioritization
applicability: Large GWAS meta-analysis is available
The target question asks for druggable candidates
Immune-cell eQTL or chromatin data can provide mechanism context

evidence_links.decision_rule: Flag genes with both genetic support and druggable protein class as priority candidates
evidence_links.why_this_link: Known RA therapies overlap GWAS genes, so the druggable genome is an informative early filter

stop_downgrade_rules: Do not claim clinical efficacy from genetic support alone
Downgrade candidates whose mechanism cell type is unverified
Report safety blockers before ranking when a candidate has known toxicity signals
mixed_method_rationale: RA was one of the first diseases where GWAS genes visibly overlapped approved therapies, so the paper-style strategy starts with genetics, then filters through the druggable genome and immune-cell mechanism before perturbation.
boundary_notes: Druggability is a feasibility filter, not evidence of disease causality

source_papers.title: Genetics of rheumatoid arthritis contributes to biology and drug discovery

name: Single-cell eQTL cell-type-resolved genetics
applicability: Single-cell or single-nucleus data with donor genotypes is available
The task needs cell-type resolution of a genetic association
Bulk eQTL is too diluted to interpret the locus

evidence_links.decision_rule: Only claim cell-type specificity when the eQTL effect differs across cell types with formal interaction evidence
evidence_links.why_this_link: Bulk eQTL can mask opposite effects in rare cell types that drive disease

stop_downgrade_rules: Do not call a locus cell-type-specific without an interaction test
Stop when donor counts per cell type are too low for pseudobulk reliability
Keep the eQTL discovery and disease colocalization steps separately auditable
mixed_method_rationale: For loci whose signal is diluted in bulk tissue, the strategy starts with genetics and immediately re-anchors with single-cell eQTL before any mechanism writing; this avoids the bulk-eQTL false negative.
boundary_notes: Single-cell eQTL power depends heavily on donor and cell-type counts

source_papers.title: Single-cell eQTL analysis identifies cell type-specific genetic control of gene expression in humans
The GTEx Consortium atlas of genetic regulatory effects across human tissues

name: Multi-ancestry genetics-first target discovery
applicability: Multi-ancestry GWAS summary statistics are available
An islet or metabolic cell-type context can be queried through eQTL or single-cell data
The question is about causal metabolic genes rather than biomarker discovery

evidence_links.decision_rule: Require colocalization posterior above the project threshold before naming a gene
evidence_links.why_this_link: T2D variants rarely map to the nearest gene; islet eQTL anchors the variant to a credible effector transcript
evidence_links.independence_note: GWAS and eQTL are separate data-generating processes; colocalization is still statistical

evidence_links.decision_rule: Only promote genes with a tissue-matched perturbation readout; otherwise CONDITIONAL_GO
evidence_links.why_this_link: Expression change alone cannot separate driver from response in islet cells

stop_downgrade_rules: Do not promote a variant-only association to target without a mechanism anchor
Stop ranking when no tissue-matched eQTL/pQTL exists; report the gap instead of guessing the gene
Downgrade to CONDITIONAL_GO when perturbation evidence is predicted rather than observed
If allele directions disagree across ancestries, keep the conflict visible and do not average it away
mixed_method_rationale: T2D heritability is distributed across many common variants, so the paper starts with a powerful multi-ancestry genetic scan, then anchors variants to islet eQTL before any perturbation claim; starting with generic omics would waste the strongest prior signal.
boundary_notes: Multi-ancestry evidence reduces but does not remove population-specific confounding
The pattern is a strategy hint, not evidence for the current task

source_papers.title: Multi-ancestry genetic study of type 2 diabetes highlights the power of diverse populations for discovery and translation

name: Trait-to-gene-program-to-cell-state causal modelling
applicability: The question is about how variants act through gene programs to change a cell state or trait
Variant-to-effect data and cell-state expression programs are available
A perturbation oracle or screen can test program membership
The task explicitly wants causal intermediate steps, not only a gene list

evidence_links.decision_rule: A variant only implicates a program when membership and effect direction are jointly supported
evidence_links.why_this_link: Single-gene effect models miss the polygenic reality that variants act through coherent programs

evidence_links.decision_rule: Require a perturbation readout to distinguish driver programs from responses
evidence_links.why_this_link: Correlation between a program and a cell state does not establish causal direction

stop_downgrade_rules: Do not claim a gene causes a trait from variant association alone
Stop when the program-to-trait link has no perturbation or natural-experiment support
Report the applicability boundary: this pattern is not valid for arbitrary disease inputs
Keep the paper's reported accuracy separate from the project's extended reproduction
mixed_method_rationale: The MCH-style approach starts from trait-associated variants, maps them to gene programs, and only then tests program-to-cell-state links with perturbation; this order prevents the common mistake of treating any differentially expressed gene as causal.
boundary_notes: This is the scientific gold-sample pattern; non-matching inputs must return out_of_scope instead of forcing the graph
Predicted perturbation results must stay PREDICTED and cannot enter formal ranking outside the trained context

source_papers.title: A saturated map of common genetic variants associated with human height
